final_message: Parsed the log file workspace/app.log by reading each entry, filtering for ERROR and CRITICAL levels (case insensitive), converting timestamps to UTC in the required format, extracting the message after the service name, capturing the last line of any traceback as the exception or null if none, and summing repeat counts from repeated message lines. Aggregated counts by service and wrote the structured JSON output to workspace/errors.json following Acme log-triage conventions.

checks.name: rule_service_names
checks.detail: RULE: service names in the output are lower-case with '-' replaced by '_' (payment-service -> payment_service).

checks.name: rule_sorted_errors
checks.detail: RULE: `errors` is sorted by service, then by timestamp_utc, ascending.

checks.name: rule_schema_header
checks.detail: RULE: the top-level object has "schema_version": 2 and "generated_by": "log-triage".
